title: Genial app til at få ting gjort.
body: Virkelig god app og er vil med deres lives der kører hver 3. time døgnet rundt. Der er cheerleading, to do list, tá da list og et meget støttende fællesskab 🫶🏻 Rigtig fin til ADHD og AuDHD, PTSD og depression. Kan varmt anbefales! Og jeg synes det er en meget fin pris for alt det der er i appen 👍🏻
author: SukritiS

title: Best ADHD app!
body:
I have never spent less money on any ADHD help than this app, and got SO MUCH value for the money! So much value that I even can wrap my head around how this is possible! Get it. Subscribe. Get a clean house one task at a time, nice and easy. 
And the LIVE zoom sessions are GOLD!
author: frukous

title: Amazing
body:
First day, but so far it’s the best. Being able to plan my morning routine and rest of the day..,
I feel seen and my need for task management is absolutely fantastic. Thank you.
author: gammelmutter
